accessibe.com Aug 26, 2026

Accessibility audit Report

This audit evaluates accessibe.com (https://accessibe.com) against WCAG 2.2 at the AA conformance level for 3 page templates: Home, Partners, and VPAT. Both desktop and mobile responsive layouts were tested where applicable. Third-party embedded content was noted but not evaluated in detail.

Methodology & Appendix

Methodology

This audit assesses conformance with the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) through a combination of manual testing techniques and automated evaluation tools. Manual testing includes navigating each page using only a keyboard, testing with screen reading software, and visually reviewing elements such as color contrast, text sizing, and focus indication, in order to assess how well the interface supports users of assistive technology and users with visual, motor, cognitive, or other disabilities.

Test environment

Operating Systems
macOS (latest), Windows 11
Browsers
Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, Apple Safari (latest stable)
Screen Readers
VoiceOver (macOS / Safari), NVDA (Windows / Chrome, Firefox)
Other Tools
axe DevTools, Colour Contrast Analyser (CCA), WAVE browser extension

Glossary

A structured evaluation of a website or application's conformance to accessibility standards, encompassing all pages, issues, and supporting evidence within a defined scope.

Methodology

This audit assesses conformance with the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) through a combination of manual testing techniques and automated evaluation tools. Manual testing includes navigating each page using only a keyboard, testing with screen reading software, and visually reviewing elements such as color contrast, text sizing, and focus indication, in order to assess how well the interface supports users of assistive technology and users with visual, motor, cognitive, or other disabilities.

Automated tools are used to surface candidates for review, such as missing alternative text, invalid ARIA, and contrast failures. Every automated result is verified by an auditor before it is recorded as a finding. Issues that cannot be detected reliably by automation are identified only through expert manual evaluation.

Testing covers both desktop and mobile responsive layouts where applicable. Third-party embedded content is noted when encountered but is not evaluated in detail unless it is part of the agreed scope.

Findings are classified by severity, mapped to the relevant WCAG success criteria, and documented with evidence so that remediation can be prioritized and verified in later reviews.

Accessibility impact definitions

  • Critical

    Content or functionality is completely unusable for one or more groups of users with disabilities. Immediate remediation required.

  • High

    Significant barrier that severely degrades the experience. A workaround may exist but is difficult to discover. Prioritize remediation.

  • Medium

    Causes difficulty or frustration but does not prevent task completion. Plan remediation in the normal development cycle.

  • Low

    Minor inconvenience with limited impact. Remediate when the affected component is next updated.
